name: Supplier scorecard
prompt: supplier scorecard: lead time trends, PO value by supplier, and flag anyone averaging more than 3 days late

binding.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT is_late
  FROM shipment_performance
  WHERE delivered IS NOT NULL
    AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
    AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1), 0.0) AS late_share_pct
FROM filtered

copy.title: Late shipment share
copy.caption: 21.6% of delivered shipments were late in the selected period.

binding.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 1), 0) AS value
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)

copy.title: Average delay days
copy.caption: Delivered shipments arrived 0.5 days early on average.

binding.sql:
WITH supplier_delays AS (
  SELECT
    supplier,
    AVG(delay_days) AS avg_delay_days
  FROM shipment_performance
  WHERE delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
    AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
    AND delay_days IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY supplier
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS supplier_count
FROM supplier_delays
WHERE avg_delay_days > 3

copy.title: Suppliers over 3 days late
copy.caption: No suppliers had an average delay above 3 days in the selected period.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', delivered) AS month,
  carrier,
  AVG(delay_days) AS avg_delay_days
FROM shipment_performance
WHERE delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
  AND delay_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY month, carrier

copy.title: Carrier delay trends
copy.caption: DB Schenker averaged the longest delays, while FedEx and Maersk delivered ahead of schedule.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  s.name AS supplier,
  ROUND(SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_price), 2) AS po_value
FROM purchase_orders AS po
JOIN suppliers AS s
  ON po.supplier_id = s.id
WHERE po.ordered_at >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND po.ordered_at <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY po_value DESC
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Supplier PO value ranking
copy.caption: Huang & Sons, Ltd had the highest purchase order value in the selected period.

binding.sql: SELECT supplier AS supplier, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count, ROUND(AVG(delay_days), 1) AS avg_delay_days FROM shipment_performance WHERE delivered >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE) AND delivered <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE) AND delay_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY supplier HAVING AVG(delay_days) > 3 ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC, shipment_count DESC LIMIT 50

copy.title: Late supplier exceptions
copy.caption: No suppliers averaged more than 3 delay days in the selected period.
